name: wp-value-length-cap
description: [PLUGIN BEHAVIOR] Field values pass two sanitizeValue passes: 256 chars at getQueryParams, then 128 at mapQueryFields -> effective cap 128 for touch fields. Referrers cap at 256. Engine caps everything at 512.
quirk_decision: CONTRACT (ruled 14+16): uniform 512-char cap kept; control chars deleted. Plugin's two-pass 128/256 caps recorded as accident/documented deviation. The 131-char campaign value survives intact.
